summary.text: Smelly fly flowers are Gu materials that grow on animal faeces and appear among flower materials used in refinement.

claims.text: In Zhao Lian Yun’s memory, Ma Hong Yun brings her a bunch of flowers on a grassland, saying women love flowers. She covers her nose in disgust and names them smelly fly flowers, which only grow on top of animal faeces, and tells him to take them away. He answers that precisely because they grow on faeces, they are big and strong.

While assisting Fang Yuan’s Gu refinement, Sixth Hair takes out flower Gu materials that include ghost face sunflowers, wire cotton, heavenly flowers, seven treasure flowers, milk tea flowers, iron shell flowers, boat flowers, blood poison kerria, multicolored overlord flowers, green beetle water lotuses, red axe flowers, smelly fly flowers, and others. The flowers vary in species and size; some are mortal Gu materials and others are immortal materials. Sixth Hair processes them into a hundred flowers concentrate used in that refinement.
